== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Armed And Dangerous & Krayt Dragon Howl (V)]] (<code>1261_93</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' text. No published image prints this version, so it was re-rendered in CardMaker (Batch B41b, Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026).

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee forum retitle of 14 July 2011 (p636351), with the original game text.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Stunning Leader (V)|Stunning Leader. OR If a battle was just initiated, ▼ (or deploy from hand) a character weapon on your participating character. LOST: Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) non-[Reflections 3] Obi-Wan. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against non-[Reflections 3] Obi-Wan alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74). Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Read by eye after rendering.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
